verdict.rationale: jo's homepage says you can give jo a job and a schedule and get recurring outputs such as a weekly plan, morning priorities, or a weekend task review without asking each time. Its own always-on cloud machine lets it work overnight and prepare results before you wake, and those results reach you over macOS, Telegram, WhatsApp, or email. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of one-off (single-run) scheduled tasks, in-depth docs on how schedules are configured and managed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
